annotations.title: What the Clearinghouse records say about a call sign or aircraft

description: For an Upper C-band earth station call sign: registrant, licensee FRN, former registrants on the 2020 / Nov 2025 lists, control group (FRN plus Form 323 50%+ entity ownership) with sister licensees, other call signs filed at the same dish location, and OFAC / foreign-adversary flags. For an N-number: owner of record (latest FAA MASTER file), airframe (model code + serial), registration status and expiry, certificate date, fractional / co-owners, prior airframe on the N-number, trustee / Part 121 / government flags. Free.
name: clearinghouse_record
